# Ultimate Social Worker Resource

Twelve practice locations have separate final learning guides. Preserve the jurisdiction and source/review status when summarising. Country selection does not determine cross-border legal responsibility. This is a learning aid, not legal advice.

- [Start Here (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/start-here.html): Orientation, law-watch notes, and the core practice formula for the whole pack.
- [Learning Map (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/learning-map.html): A study route, decision map, and 8-week programme for building confidence.
- [Case Route Finder (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/case-route-finder.html): A guided route-checker for matching case facts to legal frameworks and recording points.
- [Learning Flashcards (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/learning-flashcards.html): Module-by-module flashcards for quick revision, supervision prompts, and student refreshers.
- [Student and ASYE Pathway (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/student-and-asye-pathway.html): A guided pathway for students, newly qualified social workers, and practice educators.
- [Practice Glossary (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/practice-glossary.html): Plain-English practice terms for legal literacy, recording, supervision, and revision.
- [Theory Into Practice (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/theory-into-practice.html): Social work theory lenses with cautious hypotheses to test in assessment, supervision, and recording.
- [Children and Family Practice Models (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/children-and-family-practice-models.html): Children's social work models, tools, and practice approaches with cautious use prompts.
- [CPD and Reflection Log (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/cpd-and-reflection-log.html): A private browser-based reflection log for learning notes, supervision questions, and next actions.
- [Professional Foundations (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/professional-foundations.html): Values, standards, analysis, supervision, professional curiosity, and evidence.
- [Care Act 2014 (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/care-act-2014.html): Assessment, eligibility, wellbeing, advocacy, carers, planning, and review.
- [Mental Capacity Act 2005 (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/mental-capacity-act-2005.html): Decision-specific capacity, support, best interests, IMCA, restraint, and records.
- [DoLS and Deprivation of Liberty (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/dols-and-deprivation-of-liberty.html): DoLS, Court authorisation, objection, consent, and the 2026 legal update.
- [Mental Health Act (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/mental-health-act.html): Civil sections, AMHP analysis, MCA/DoLS interface, Section 117, and reform watch.
- [Safeguarding Adults (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/safeguarding-adults.html): Section 42, Making Safeguarding Personal, self-neglect, domestic abuse, and enquiries.
- [Children, Families, and Transitions (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/children-families-and-transitions.html): Whole-family practice, children in need, child protection, SEND, young carers, and transition.
- [Equality, Human Rights, and Recording (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/equality-human-rights-and-recording.html): Equality, reasonable adjustments, human rights analysis, anti-oppressive practice, and records.
- [Quick Reference (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/quick-reference.html): A fast legal map, threshold checks, risk flags, and decision reminders.
- [Templates and Checklists (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/templates-and-checklists.html): Reusable assessment, safeguarding, MCA, best interests, supervision, and risk templates.
- [Printable Tools (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/printable-tools.html): Downloadable and printable practice prompts for assessments, MCA, safeguarding, and supervision.
- [Practice Scenarios (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/practice-scenarios.html): Applied scenarios for supervision, ASYE learning, workshops, and private study.
- [Source Library (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/source-library.html): Official and authoritative links for checking current law, guidance, and standards.
- [About Us (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/about-us.html): Daily Mindset Moments, Raymond Hill, the mission, and the wider product ecosystem.
- [Contact Us (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/contact-us.html): Contact Daily Mindset Moments CIC about the resource, partnerships, and practical AI builds.
- [Privacy Policy (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/privacy-policy.html): How this resource handles local progress data, contact enquiries, and external links.
- [Terms of Service (england)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/terms-of-service.html): Use of the learning resource, legal disclaimer, acceptable use, and external services.
- [Start Here — Wales (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/start-here-wales.html): An introduction to the Wales learning guide.
- [Learning Map (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/learning-map.html): A suggested route through the Wales guide.
- [Case Route Finder (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/case-route-finder.html): Explore Welsh practice sources relevant to a situation.
- [Learning Flashcards (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/learning-flashcards.html): Forty revision cards across eight Wales learning modules.
- [Student and Newly Qualified Pathway (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/student-and-newly-qualified-pathway.html): A starting point for Welsh professional learning.
- [Practice Glossary (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/practice-glossary.html): Search 28 Wales practice terms and open the relevant module.
- [Theory Into Practice (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/theory-into-practice.html): Explore theory lenses and test competing hypotheses in Welsh practice.
- [Children and Family Practice Models (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/children-and-family-practice-models.html): Compare children’s practice models and identify questions for assessment.
- [CPD and Reflection Log (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/cpd-and-reflection-log.html): A separate private reflection space for Wales.
- [Professional Foundations (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/professional-foundations.html): Explain your professional role, distinguish an ethical concern from a statutory power, and turn a formulation into an accountable plan.
- [Care and Support in Wales (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/care-and-support-in-wales.html): Map assessment, eligibility, funding and delivery separately; include family support without assuming it; explain the local route for challenging a decision.
- [Mental Capacity Act 2005 (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/mental-capacity-act-2005.html): Identify the precise decision, provide practical decision support, apply the local capacity or consent framework and verify a representative’s authority.
- [DoLS and Deprivation of Liberty (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/dols-and-deprivation-of-liberty.html): Describe actual restrictions, identify the setting-specific legal authority, test alternatives and make representation and review practical.
- [Mental Health in Wales (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/mental-health-in-wales.html): Distinguish voluntary care, compulsory assessment, detention and treatment; connect the local criteria to evidence and explain the person’s review rights.
- [Safeguarding Adults in Wales (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/safeguarding-adults-in-wales.html): Recognise abuse, neglect and coercion; choose the correct local reporting route; connect immediate protection to the adult’s wishes and continuing support.
- [Children, Families and Transitions (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/children-families-and-transitions.html): Separate family support from protection powers, apply the local reporting duty, involve the child and coordinate education, health and transition planning.
- [Rights, Language and Recording (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/rights-language-and-recording.html): Connect rights to an actual service decision, distinguish privacy from absolute secrecy and write a record that makes reasons and disagreement visible.
- [Quick Reference (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/quick-reference.html): Official starting points for common Welsh practice topics.
- [Templates and Checklists (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/templates-and-checklists.html): Ten Wales recording structures with individual and combined downloads.
- [Printable Tools (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/printable-tools.html): Download ten Wales practice prompts, individually or as a collection.
- [Practice Scenarios (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/practice-scenarios.html): Eight fictional cases with questions and worked discussions.
- [Source Library (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/source-library.html): Official starting points for the Wales practice guide.
- [About Us (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/about-us.html): Daily Mindset Moments, Raymond Hill, the mission, and the wider product ecosystem.
- [Contact Us (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/contact-us.html): Contact Daily Mindset Moments CIC about the resource, partnerships, and practical AI builds.
- [Privacy Policy (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/privacy-policy.html): How this resource handles local progress data, contact enquiries, and external links.
- [Terms of Service (wales)](https://social-work-resource.netlify.app/learning/wales/terms-of-service.html): Use of the learning resource, legal disclaimer, acceptable use, and external services.
